title: Latent Class Mixed Model Variational Autoencoders for Scalable Phenotyping of Health Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2611.32391v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clustering longitudinal health trajectories requires handling high-dimensional measurements, irregular visit times, and subject-level heterogeneity while retaining clinically interpretable structure. Existing methods address this only partially: latent-class mixed models yield an interpretable, covariate-driven partition but do not scale past a handful of markers, while deep time-series clustering scales at the cost of that structure and generally requires a common time grid. We introduce the Latent Class Mixed Model Variational Autoencoder (LCMM-VAE), a deep generative model whose latent prior is a mixture of class-specific linear mixed models, so that each subject's latent trajectory decomposes into its class mean trajectory and a subject-specific deviation. We derive a variational EM algorithm whose class responsibilities, random effects and mixed-model parameters are updated in closed form, and provide identifiability guarantees un

translated_title: 用于健康轨迹可扩展表型分析的潜类别混合模型变分自编码器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.32391v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：对纵向健康轨迹进行聚类需要处理高维测量数据、不规则的就诊时间以及受试者层面的异质性，同时还要保留临床可解释的结构。现有方法只能部分解决这一问题：潜类别混合模型能够产生可解释的、由协变量驱动的划分，但无法扩展到超过少数几个标志物的情形；而深度时间序列聚类虽然具备可扩展性，却牺牲了这种结构，并且通常要求统一的时间网格。我们提出了潜类别混合模型变分自编码器（LCMM-VAE），这是一种深度生成模型，其潜变量先验是类别特定的线性混合模型的混合，因此每个受试者的潜轨迹可以分解为其所属类别的均值轨迹和个体特异性偏差。我们推导了一种变分EM算法，其中的类别归属责任、随机效应和混合模型参数均以闭式解形式更新，并提供了可辨识性保证……
tldr: 提出LCMM-VAE，一种以类别特定线性混合模型的混合作为潜变量先验的深度生成模型，通过闭式变分EM算法，实现了对高维、不规则采样纵向健康轨迹的可扩展且临床可解释的聚类表型分析。
en_tdlr: Proposes LCMM-VAE, a deep generative model with a mixture of class-specific linear mixed models as its latent prior, enabling scalable and clinically interpretable clustering of high-dimensional, irregularly sampled longitudinal health trajectories via a closed-form variational EM algorithm.
